items.claim: ListEditor's Enter does not commit the draft at `maxItems` or with no entry kind
items.note: with a follow-up 869d6b1385 that keeps the function under the size cap.

items.claim: MeshHandles ignores Disabled and ReadOnly scopes
items.note: The shared `HandleOverlay` now takes the control's hold and gates every point's edits by it, and `MeshHandles` takes hold props. The changeset title was shortened in 15525b2569.

items.claim: PageTabs draws its drop line on the wrong edge in RTL
OpacityRange's dead-track style misses a range disabled for a reason
MeshHandles remounts and welds a point moved onto another
items.note: In the renderer, `meshHandles` no longer merges two points of the same patch. In ui, MeshHandles settles which points are one handle when a gesture starts and keeps that until it ends. A point landing on another patch's point still becomes one handle once the drag ends, because that is `meshHandles`' rule for shared seams.

items.claim: Jog's Pause is disabled while playing once `count` drops below 2
Jog drops a falsy caption such as `0`
items.note: JogAlong reads the same part, so the curved layout already agreed with the straight one; both now draw a `0`.

items.claim: A `current` MenuButton is not held by a ReadOnly scope
Legend's dot swatch is offset on the wrong side in RTL
KeymapHint story ignores its `label` control after the first render
items.note: Stories don't ship, so there is no changeset.

items.claim: A bare MenuButton disabled for a reason is drawn enabled
GradientHandles ignored Disabled and ReadOnly scopes, the same mistake as MeshHandles through the same overlay
items.note: It now takes `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `readOnly` and `readOnlyReason`, so its changeset is `minor` and tagged `fix api`.

items.claim: `useLastOperation` in `@weasel-js/routing` passed `store.get` and `store.subscribe` to `useSyncExternalStore` unbound, so a store written as a class broke there too
